meta: Protect your search traffic when you move platform or change URLs, with redirect maps and checks. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: SEO migration care for platform and URL changes
overview: Moving to a new platform or changing page addresses can erase years of search visibility if it is not planned. We list every important page on the old site, map each one to its new address, and set up the redirects so visitors and search engines arrive in the right place. We check titles, tags and sitemaps on the new site before launch and watch Search Console after it. The work is done with your web developer or platform team.

faq: Do you do the platform move itself?
This service protects your search traffic during the move. The migration of products and pages can be quoted from our store migration services, or done by your own developer.
Will I lose my rankings during the move?
Some movement is normal after a move. With careful mapping and redirects, we aim to keep it small and short. We cannot promise that rankings stay exactly the same.
Before the move, ideally. A page inventory is easiest while the old site is still live. If you have already moved, tell us, and we repair redirects and check what was lost.
What do you need from me?
A list or export of your old pages if you have it, access to Search Console and analytics, and contact with whoever builds the new site.
